owner_rule.disposition_rule: Compare real task effects on equivalent inputs and environment before replacement; keep uncertainty and use a low-cost controlled comparison where evidence is insufficient.

blueprint_source.head: acf2caebbb615d2827d1767a7a17358f8de38fc4
blueprint_source.target_scope: Portable versioned research episode with explicit planned/attempted/executed/not-executed states, used/attached/produced references, version-bound reviews, omissions, and read-only fork ID remaps.

frozen_task.question: Are the caller-declared episode manifest schema and its artifact-version, dependency, run-state, review-target, omission, and fork-map relationships internally consistent?
frozen_task.input_object: One UTF-8 JSON manifest supplied on stdin, capped at 262144 bytes.
frozen_task.quality_requirement: Return bounded typed conflicts/warnings and preserve the non-authentication and non-execution claim ceiling.
frozen_task.environment: Local Python 3.9+ CLI with local R0 schema and jsonschema Draft 2020-12 support.
frozen_task.authority: READ_ONLY_RUN; no file/package import, execution, network, writes, or publication action.

comparison_attempt.method: Low-cost source-contract and route-surface comparison against adjacent toolbox capabilities, plus a real task-derived input run of the candidate. No adjacent tool accepts this same manifest object and output contract.

observations.coverage: Caller-declared agent execution plan roles, context access, feedback, write domains, and work-unit dependency DAG.
observations.not_covered: Portable artifact version and parent relations, declared run state, separate used/attached/produced artifact references, version-pinned review targets, omissions, and fork identifier maps.

observations.coverage: Current local bytes of receipt-referenced regular files versus caller-declared SHA-256 values, within explicit path and byte limits.
observations.not_covered: Episode semantics and review/run/fork relationships; it also performs byte reads which this manifest validator deliberately does not.

comparison_limits: The candidate invocation used a real PR #264 task-derived caller manifest, but all run IDs, artifact hashes, and execution declarations remain unauthenticated input assertions.

The neighboring tools require different typed objects, so their failures on this manifest would measure schema incompatibility rather than task capability; no such failure is counted as a losing result.
No matched baseline can establish comparative correctness, reliability, task coverage, maintenance burden, or cost.

c1_disposition.unique_scope_observed: The local contract exposes explicit episode artifact-version, run status, used/attached/produced, review-version, omission, and fork-map relation checks that the inspected adjacent validators do not declare.
c1_disposition.next_low_cost_comparison: When a natural portable-episode consumer provides the same manifest task to a second capable implementation, bind both to identical manifest bytes and environment; compare typed conflict detection, omission and version coverage, false accepts/rejects, and wall/CPU/memory. Until then keep the candidate optional and default-off, with cost UNKNOWN.

claim_ceiling: This scope comparison does not show that the candidate is more accurate, reliable, cheaper, safer in all environments, or a replacement for either adjacent tool.
